basic_details.job_title: IIT (BHU) Varanasi Research Associate I Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi (IIT BHU) has published the Research Associate I Notification 2026 on its official website, https://www.iitbhu.ac.in. The recruitment drive aims to fill 1 Research Associate I position. Candidates up to 35 years of age and holding a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or an equivalent allied discipline, or those with three years of research/teaching experience after M.E./M.Tech along with at least one SCI journal publication, are eligible to apply. qualification.details: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engg / Chemical Engineering or equivalent degree of any allied branches with related areas to the project or three years of research/teaching experience after ME/M.Tech with at least One research paper published in Science Citation Indexed (SCI) journal. The candidates who have submitted their Ph.D. thesis and having consistently good academic records are also eligible for the position.

selection_process: academic record and relevant experience Interview Document Verification
how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT (BHU) Varanasi Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT (BHU) Varanasi Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 19-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT (BHU) Varanasi Research Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your email application for the Research Associate-I position at IIT (BHU) Varanasi is 19th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering, or an equivalent degree in allied branches. Alternatively, three years of research/teaching experience after ME/M.Tech with a published SCI journal paper is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate-I post is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 58,000 plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT (BHU) Varanasi Research Associate-I job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your complete bio-data and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Research Associate-I in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Research Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting candidates based on eligibility, academic records, and relevant experience, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at the Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi.
